_comment: Clause 2 ('Create a Ponder token for each hero dealt damage this way') has no heroes-damaged-by-this-effect counter; modeled as CREATE_TOKEN count = LAST_DAMAGE_DEALT, which reads state._last_damage_dealt published by the canonical deal_damage primitive once damage lands past prevention/replacement (effect_keywords.py ~517; effect_deal_arcane routes through it). Exact in 1v1 whenever the damage lands (1 damage -> 1 Ponder; prevented -> 0). Two known edges: (1) if the arcane damage is FULLY prevented/canceled, _last_damage_dealt retains the value of the last unrelated damage effect earlier this turn, so a spurious Ponder could be created; (2) 'each opposing hero' is authored as the single OPPONENT target DEAL_ARCANE supports - a multiplayer game would undercount, but the sim is 1v1. ponder token definition already exists (json/tokens/ponder.json); CREATE_TOKEN spelling copied from codex_of_inertia_yellow.
